title: Education and the nation: the rural school
goal: Describe changes that grow together, with *a medida que* and *cuanto más ..., más ...*.

items: I can link two changes that grow together, with *a medida que* or *cuanto más ..., más ...*.
I can say what the SEP and the cultural missions were.
I can say what children learned at the new rural schools.
I can use the words *el maestro*, *la biblioteca*, *la bandera* and *el himno*.
